say: Ten real space fails. Number one? Mission Control said it out loud.
An astronaut smuggled a corned beef sandwich into orbit. Crumbs everywhere. Congress got involved.
A spacewalker let go of a hundred thousand dollar tool bag. It orbited Earth for months.
Alan Shepard golfed on the Moon. Miles and miles, he said. It went about forty yards.
Apollo sixteen. Gravity, one. Astronaut, zero.
One team used feet. The other used meters. Goodbye, hundred and twenty five million dollar Mars orbiter.
America's first satellite launch. It rose four feet... then exploded. Newspapers called it Flopnik.
Two months later... they tried again.
Gene Cernan, the last man on the Moon, hitting the dirt.
Apollo ten, actual transcript. Give me a napkin, quick. There's a turd floating through the air. Nobody ever confessed.
And number one. Jack Schmitt kept falling and knocking stuff over, until Mission Control radioed: Hey Gene, would you go over and help Twinkletoes, please?
